trigger: Ambient: the stranded trucker at her reefer trailer.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: A Freightliner parked crooked off USA Parkway. A reefer trailer, the diesel unit chugging. A woman with a thermos.

nodes.speaker: amb_darlene
nodes.text: Darlene. Phoenix to Boise, chicken. Got stuck at the Mustang exit Day Zero. Chicken's frozen, at least.

nodes.speaker: amb_darlene
nodes.text: I been feeding the shelter on Greg Street. Can't move a forty-ton truck on what's left in the tank.

choices.text: How long can the reefer run?

nodes.speaker: amb_darlene
nodes.text: Ten days. Then it's six thousand pounds of chicken thawing in the desert. Make it make sense.

nodes.speaker: amb_darlene
nodes.text: Well bless you. Come by anytime. I'll fry you a wing on the manifold.
